NOTE 13 — LEASES
We have operating and finance leases for datacenters, corporate offices, research and development facilities, and certain equipment. Our leases have remaining lease terms of less than 1 year to 20 years, some of which include options to extend the leases for up to 5 years, and some of which include options to terminate the leases within 1 year.
